summary: The add-on foundation is properly implemented with correct Blender add-on structure, proper bl_info metadata, and functional registration/unregistration. All required components are present and follow Blender conventions.

issues.description: The preferences.py file mentioned in AGENTS.md conventions does not exist - preferences are implemented directly in __init__.py. This is acceptable for a simple add-on but deviates from the documented convention.

sharedStateObservations.description: Add-on follows Blender's standard registration pattern: classes list, register() and unregister() functions, and bl_info dict with required fields.
File structure differs from AGENTS.md conventions: preferences are in __init__.py instead of separate preferences.py file. The separate file approach is documented but not enforced.
